Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Goal! Paderborn 0, Stuttgart 1. Jeff Chabot (Stuttgart) header from the right side of the six yard box to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Angelo Stiller following a set piece situation.
Marvin Pieringer (Paderborn) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Delay in match because of an injury Jeff Chabot (Stuttgart).
Substitution, Paderborn. Steffen Tigges replaces Stefano Marino.
Substitution, Paderborn. Rayan Philippe replaces Marvin Pieringer.
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Substitution, Stuttgart. Finn Jeltsch replaces Jeff Chabot because of an injury.
Substitution, Stuttgart. Dzenan Pejcinovic replaces Ermedin Demirovic.
Substitution, Stuttgart. Bilal El Khannouss replaces Jamie Leweling.
Substitution, Paderborn. Oliver Batista Meier replaces Laurin Ulrich.
Goal! Paderborn 0, Stuttgart 2. Chris Führich (Stuttgart) left footed shot from the left side of the box to the high centre of the goal. Assisted by Angelo Stiller.
Substitution, Paderborn. Felix Götze replaces Mattes Hansen.
Substitution, Paderborn. Jonah Sticker replaces Tjark Scheller.
Substitution, Stuttgart. Grischa Prömel replaces Deniz Undav.
